Services

Full-Service Guidance

One trusted partner across real estate and property ownership.

Coastal & Arbor Real Estate Group provides residential and commercial real estate, property management, leasing, and investment services throughout Hampton Roads.

Residential Real Estate

Whether you’re buying your dream home, selling your current property, relocating, or purchasing an investment property, we provide expert guidance from consultation to closing. Every transaction is handled with professionalism, transparency, and your long-term goals in mind.

Services Include

  • Buyer Representation
  • Seller Representation
  • First-Time Homebuyers
  • Luxury & Investment Properties
  • Comparative Market Analysis (CMAs)
  • Professional Listing Marketing
  • Skilled Negotiation
  • Contract-to-Closing Coordination

Commercial Real Estate

Whether you’re leasing office space, purchasing commercial property, or expanding your investment portfolio, we help businesses and investors navigate the commercial real estate market with confidence.

Services Include

  • Commercial Sales
  • Commercial Leasing
  • Investment Properties
  • Office, Retail & Industrial Properties
  • Market Analysis
  • Lease Negotiation
  • Investment Consulting

Residential Property Management

Owning rental property should be rewarding-not overwhelming.

Our full-service residential property management is designed to protect your investment while maximizing its performance. From marketing vacancies to handling maintenance and owner reporting, we manage every aspect of the day-to-day operations.

Services Include

  • Tenant Placement
  • Professional Marketing
  • Tenant Screening
  • Lease Preparation & Renewals
  • Rent Collection
  • Maintenance Coordination
  • Routine Property Inspections
  • Owner Statements & Financial Reporting
  • Security Deposit Administration
  • Virginia Landlord-Tenant Compliance
  • Eviction Coordination

Commercial Property Management

We provide professional management services for office buildings, executive suites, retail centers, industrial properties, warehouses, and mixed-use developments.

Our customized management approach focuses on tenant retention, operational efficiency, property maintenance, lease administration, and protecting the long-term value of your investment.

Services Include

  • Tenant Relations
  • Lease Administration
  • Maintenance Coordination
  • Vendor Management
  • Financial Reporting
  • Budget Oversight
  • Property Inspections
  • Occupancy Management

Leasing Services

Need a qualified tenant without ongoing management?

Our leasing services help property owners minimize vacancy time by professionally marketing their property, conducting thorough tenant screening, preparing lease agreements, and coordinating a smooth move-in process.

Discuss Leasing

Short-Term & Mid-Term Rental Management

Whether your property is designed for vacation guests, corporate housing, traveling professionals, military families, or insurance placements, we provide customized management solutions tailored to your goals.

We handle the details so you can enjoy the benefits of ownership.

Services Include

  • Property Setup & Launch
  • Listing Management
  • Guest Communication
  • Reservation Management
  • Cleaning Coordination
  • Maintenance Oversight
  • Revenue Optimization
  • Owner Reporting

Investment Services

Whether you’re purchasing your first investment property or expanding an established portfolio, we understand that every investment decision matters.

We help clients identify opportunities, evaluate returns, and create long-term strategies designed to build wealth through real estate.

Services Include

  • Investment Property Analysis
  • Rental Income Projections
  • Portfolio Growth Strategies
  • Property Evaluations
  • Exit Planning
  • Transition into Professional Management
